name: system.shutdown
description: Initiates an OS-level shutdown. Connection drops once the OS issues the shutdown signal — clients should treat absence of an OK as expected. Extra-risky (X) verb; agents may require an elevated tier or explicit policy grant before honouring it.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before initiating shutdown. Zero means immediate.

force.description: Force-close applications without prompting. Maps to EWX_FORCE on Windows, -h on macOS.

reason.description: Free-form reason logged with the shutdown event. Surfaced in Windows Event Log and macOS unified log.

windows-modern.description: InitiateSystemShutdownExW with delay_seconds, force, and reason mapped through. Requires SeShutdownPrivilege (auto-enabled if held). Connection drops once the OS issues the shutdown.

windows-classic.description: ExitWindowsEx(EWX_SHUTDOWN [| EWX_FORCE]) on NT 4 / 2000 / XP / Vista / 7 / 8.x. On 9x without admin this is a no-op-with-error rather than a silent fail.
